C1194.title: XuShui Procuratorate Handles Li's SMS Bombing Software Sales Case
C1194.summary: Between August 2023 and November 2025, Li purchased SMS bombing software at low cost online and advertised it on platforms like Kuaishou and Douyin to resell at a markup or directly offer SMS bombing services. After buyers contacted him via QQ and paid, they used the software to send massive verification SMS messages to target phones, severely disrupting normal phone functions. Li sold software or provided services more than 800 times, illegally earning over 20,000 yuan, and was approved for arrest.

references.title: Prosecutorial Case Analysis: How Can 'SMS Bombing' Be a 'Business Opportunity'? Illegal Profits Lead to Criminal Liability!
